# Copilot instructions

Follow every instruction in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

This is a beginner vanilla HTML/CSS practice sandbox. Do not introduce frameworks or libraries. Keep changes small and explained so the student can read every line.

Every generated or substantially rewritten code or content region must be wrapped in AI citation comments containing the student's prompt, and every such interaction must also be logged in `citations.html` (create it if it does not exist). Never remove existing citations.
